in_sanskrit.name: Ruṇjūn
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who brings joy, the one who delights

in_hindi.name: रुँजुन
in_hindi.meaning: रुँजना (rujnā) - खुशियों वापसी (khushiyōn vāpasī) - खुशिया (khushiyā) - खुशी (khushī)
in_hindi.long_meaning: वह जो खुशियों वापस करने वाला है (vah jō khushiyōn vāpas kar nē hai) - The one who brings back happiness

in_tamil.name: ருஞ்ஜுன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: இவர்கள் அன்பவன் (ivarqaḷ anbavāṉ) - The one who gives love to everyone

in_telugu.name: రుఞ్జూన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఆశదేహియోజనేయయేహీ (āśadēhīyōjayōjanēyēhī) - The one who gives joy, the one who delights

in_marathi.name: Runjhun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Runjhun हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Runjhun is derived from the Hindi word 'Runjhun', which means 'Jasmine flower'. This name is often given to babies born during the Jasmine flowering season.

in_bengali.name: Runjhun
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Jasmine flower
in_bengali.long_meaning: Runjhun একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Runjhun is derived from the Hindi word 'Runjhun', which means 'Jasmine flower'. This name is often given to babies born during the Jasmine flowering season.
